description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Specify the region based on where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Assets are in regions outside China.
The code of the log to query.
The code of the product to query.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to query.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem list-project-log-stores --source-prod-code sas --source-log-code cloud_siem_aegis_proc --sub-user-id 123 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem ListProjectLogStores --region cn-hangzhou --SourceProdCode sas --SubUserId 123 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SourceLogCode cloud_siem_aegis_proc
